title: Categories
description: The platform's product categories, shared by every shop.

help.title: About product categories
help.overview: Categories are the platform's: one detailed tree every shop shares, so the portal can show, say, every shop's dresses together. Pick the categories your products belong to; a product can be in several.

sections.title: Each category
items: Can't find the right one? Use Request a category. The platform reviews it; until then only your shop sees it.
Your own groupings, such as a season or a sale, are collections.
Your shop's menu shows only the categories your products are in, and the categories above them.
A discount aimed at a category applies when any of the product's categories matches.
A pricing rule aimed at a category looks only at the product's first category.
Your service listings use their own categories, under Listing categories.
